text: No man is independent as long as he has to depend on another man to help him. It is a reciprocal relation, the boss is the partner of his worker, the worker is partner of his boss. And such being the case, it is useless for one group or the other to assume that it is the one indispensable unit. Both are indispensable.
author: Henry Ford
reference: My Life and Work (with Samuel Crowther)
